Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics

Interface CosmeticsService

public interface CosmeticsService
The cosmetics each player owns, per category, and the one they chose in each.

Ownership is stored with the rest of the player's data, so a database shared by several servers shares it too. Every change works for offline players, applies to the data as stored now - which another server may have changed - and completes on the main thread. Online players' cosmetics are also cached, read as they join; getOwnership(java.util.UUID, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticCategory) answers from that cache.

Changes complete exceptionally while storage is unavailable, including while Zentrix runs on its in-memory stand-in for a database it could not reach; check isAvailable() first. A change that altered anything fires CosmeticOwnershipChangeEvent. 


 CosmeticsService cosmetics = ZentrixAPI.get().getCosmeticsService();
 cosmetics.grant(playerId, CosmeticCategory.GLIDERS, List.of("phoenix"))
     .thenAccept(change -> {
         if (change.changed()) {
             // unlocked
         }
     });

Every type, and your own menu (since 1.11.0)

Methods taking a CosmeticTypeKey work alike for Zentrix's own categories and for types addons register. Together they hold everything /cosmetics does, so an addon can build its own cosmetics menu, mixing in cosmetics of other plugins if it likes:

  • what there is: getTypes(), getCosmetics(CosmeticTypeKey);
  • where a player stands: getStates(Player, CosmeticTypeKey), getEquipped(Player, CosmeticTypeKey);
  • what a player does: equip(org.bukkit.entity.Player, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticTypeKey, java.lang.String), unequip(org.bukkit.entity.Player, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticTypeKey), purchase(org.bukkit.entity.Player, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticTypeKey, java.lang.String), startPreview(org.bukkit.entity.Player, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticTypeKey, java.lang.String), stopPreview(org.bukkit.entity.Player), each as the menu does it, with the same checks and events;
  • what an addon does for a player: grant, grantTimed, revoke, select.

 for (CosmeticType type : cosmetics.getTypes()) {
     if (!type.available()) continue;
     for (CosmeticState state : cosmetics.getStates(player, type.key())) {
         // draw state.cosmetic(), marked by state.equipped(), state.canUse(), state.purchasable()
     }
 }
 // on a click:
 cosmetics.equip(player, type.key(), cosmeticId).thenAccept(result -> {
     if (result.status() == CosmeticResult.Status.LOCKED) {
         // offer cosmetics.purchase(player, type.key(), cosmeticId)
     }
 });

Methods that read or act for an online Player must be called on the main thread.

Since:
1.8.0

    • grantTimed

      @NotNull default @NotNull CompletableFuture<CosmeticChange> grantTimed(@NotNull @NotNull UUID playerId, @NotNull @NotNull CosmeticCategory category, @NotNull @NotNull Collection<String> ids, @NotNull @NotNull Duration duration)
      Grants cosmetics for a limited time, such as a glider for seven days.

      A cosmetic the player does not own is granted until duration from now. One they already own for a limited time keeps its remaining time with duration added. One they own permanently is left as it is: a timed grant never shortens a permanent one.

      When the time runs out the cosmetic is taken away on its own, even while the player is offline or the server is restarting, and on every server sharing the database. A selection of it falls back to the server's default, and CosmeticOwnershipChangeEvent fires with CosmeticOwnershipChangeEvent.Cause.EXPIRED.

      Parameters:
      duration - how long to grant them for; must be positive
      Returns:
      completes on the main thread with the change
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the duration is zero or negative
      Since:
      1.9.0

    • purchase

      @NotNull @NotNull CompletableFuture<CosmeticResult> purchase(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Player player, @NotNull @NotNull CosmeticTypeKey type, @NotNull @NotNull String id)
      Buys a cosmetic for the player with Zentrix's currency and unlocks it permanently, as /cosmetics does for an addon's cosmetic with a price. Only cosmetics that are for sale and the player cannot use yet can be bought. CosmeticUnlockEvent is fired before the payment, which then goes through the currency's usual CurrencyChangeEvent. Should storing the cosmetic fail after the payment, the payment is refunded. Main thread.
      Returns:
      completes on the main thread: SUCCESS, UNKNOWN, ALREADY_UNLOCKED, NOT_FOR_SALE, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, CANCELLED, UNAVAILABLE or FAILED
      Since:
      1.11.0

    • registerType

      @NotNull @NotNull Registration registerType(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin owner, @NotNull @NotNull CosmeticTypeDefinition definition, @NotNull @NotNull CosmeticHandler handler)
      Adds a cosmetic type of the addon's own, under CosmeticTypeKey.of(owner, definition.getKey()). It works as Zentrix's own categories do:
      • /cosmetics shows a tile for it, opening the cosmetics the player can use or buy; left-click equips or buys, right-click previews;
      • ownership and choices are stored with the player's data, in every storage backend, and kept while the type is not registered;
      • a cosmetic's permission unlocks it, and one with a price can be bought;
      • the handler hears each player's equipped cosmetic at the moments the definition lists, and shows previews.

      The registration ends when the owner is disabled; ending it stops previews of the type, calls CosmeticHandler.onUnregister() and takes the tile out of /cosmetics. Not part of the Free edition, which refuses it. Main thread.

      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the owner is not enabled or the key is already registered
      UnsupportedOperationException - in the Free edition
      Since:
      1.11.0
